notes: The registry record hasResults is false and contains no posted results. The closest reported outcome to Serious adverse events is the abstract's serious adverse reactions (1/16 vs 0/14), selected here with the explicitly stated hydrocortisone vs placebo ordering. Serious adverse reactions are not explicitly described as all serious adverse events. The registry protocol defines the outcome as Number of participants with one or more serious adverse reactions, at day 14, comprising new episodes of septic shock, invasive fungal infection, clinically important GI bleeding or anaphylactic reaction. The abstract also reports mortality (6/16 vs 2/14), which is a different outcome and was not selected.
